scope: Golden T-Shirt drape fixture (fixtures/golden-tshirt-drape/v1): control measures of body models against their targets, cloth penetration and seam gaps of drapes, and the planar deviation of drape rest meshes. Fit-map relations are metamorphic expectations, not tolerances.
notes: Provisional values proposed for draft 0.3.0 (Implementierungsplan E-22/E-23, design decision ADR-029 §12): not calibrated, not to be used for comparing implementations until frozen by maintainer decision. A changed value is a new version.
